title: Unemployment rate, usual status (ps+ss), age 15+, all-India

source.title: Periodic Labour Force Survey Annual Report 2023-24, press note (Table 3)

note: Years are July-June survey rounds. PLFS began in 2017-18, so there is no strictly comparable official series for 2013-14 to 2016-17 (earlier NSSO employment-unemployment surveys used a different design). Later PLFS releases moved to calendar-year reports; secondary sources cite 3.1% for calendar 2025 but this was not checked against a MoSPI document.
